methodology: The ranked list contains only results from the RTX 4070 node above. Historical fields that were not captured in the same run are shown as not recorded instead of being inferred. Community hardware is kept in a separate, unranked dataset. Retired profiles keep their last measured performance in the archive tab; they are no longer reproducible on this node.

qwen38-flash-next-mtp.summary: PR #28243 on master with compact 1.78 GB shared-Q4_K_M draft head. Offloads 3 MoE layers to GPU (-ncmoe 45), breaking 20 t/s across all tasks: 20.65 t/s aggregate (up to 21.9-22.4 t/s on code/SQL), 77-96% draft acceptance, 11.78 GB VRAM footprint.

qwen38-flash-next.summary: 125B-A6B MoE with the 51B PLE n-gram table streamed from SSD (AtomicChat AD-4.27bpw). Plain upstream master b78a39a2f decode at 19.35 t/s steady state (up to 19.64 t/s on code), pp ~200 t/s @ 64k context (q8_0 KV, --fit on --fit-target 512, ub 2048).

qwen38-flash-next-exp.summary: Experimental tier on master + #28023 #28068 #27941: GDN l2norm correctness, indexer heads, and kvu NaN-collapse/restore. Superseded by PR #28243.

qwen38-flash-next-vision.summary: Multimodal vision tier: upstream master b78a39a2f with mmproj-F16.gguf projector. Offloads 3 MoE layers to GPU (-ncmoe 45), 18.2-18.6 t/s @ 16k ctx, 10.6 GB VRAM with 1.68 GB headroom.

qwen3-8-27b-iq3-xxs.summary: Dense 27B hybrid; middle quant tier. Fits the native 262k window in VRAM with q5_0/q4_1 KV at ~36.7 t/s — the long-context + quality play on 12 GB.
